test_LazyFrame_init: test creating a LazyFrame from a dictionary of column data and verifying its schema
test_LazyFrame_filter: test filtering a LazyFrame using column expressions, keyword arguments, and iterables
test_LazyFrame_group_by: test grouping a LazyFrame by column and aggregating with mean, implode, and custom functions
test_LazyFrame_join: test joining two LazyFrames on columns with suffix handling and self-join scenarios
test_LazyFrame_cache: test caching a LazyFrame node to reuse results across parallel concat and join operations
